stories.title: Amazon donates 30 emergency bags for people fleeing domestic abuse in north Wales
stories.summary: Thirty emergency bags for people fleeing domestic abuse are to be held at police stations across north Wales, after a donation from Amazon to North Wales Police. stories.title: Have you seen Kelly? Police searching for 36-year-old missing from Holywell
stories.summary: North Wales Police have appealed for help to find a woman missing from Holywell. The force said officers have concerns for Kelly, 36, and that she may have travelled to Towyn and the surrounding area. stories.title: Mold: First look at new joint archive for Flintshire and Denbighshire
stories.summary: Plans have revealed how Flintshire’s proposed new £13 million record office and archive will look if approved. stories.title: North Wales woman urges Senedd to act on brain cancer research after husband’s diagnosis
stories.summary: A North Wales woman is urging the Senedd to take action on brain cancer research after her husband was diagnosed with an incurable brain tumour at the age of 34. Joshua Smith, a machinist at Tritech from Wrexham, was diagnosed with a glioblastoma in January after a scan found a 4.5cm mass on his brain.
